tests.note: The change's own coverage. Includes 6 new tests (Pro Plus toggle on/off, Pro Plus mount read-back, success notification, non-admin danger notification, Pro Plus dispatcher eligibility) plus a danger-notification assertion added to the existing Basic-tier test.

1404 tests / 5589 assertions. The 3 failures were PROVEN pre-existing: reverting only the two changed app files to the pre-change base reproduced all 3 identically (CloseInactiveShiftsCommandTest x2 — the known 18000s/5h timezone delta; EnsureOpenShiftTest::test_current_open_opens_a_fresh_shift_after_a_confirmed_end). The 1 error (HasStatDrillDownTest, ClickhouseHttpClient) did NOT reproduce when that file ran in isolation — a transient local ClickHouse HTTP error, unrelated to this diff. Full suite required `vendor/bin/phpunit` with a raised memory limit because `-d memory_limit` does not reach `artisan test`'s child processes.

deviations.edit: Provisioned Docker ClickHouse mid-Phase-4 after the eager-skip gate proved wrong: DispatchRdnMetricsHourly computes hit counts in-process before the Bus::fake()'d batch, and RdnHitHourCountQuery uses countIf(), which the pgsql bridge does not implement. Also applied database/schema/local-clickhouse-schema.sql to the isolated testing DB (it had no clarity schema at all) and pointed .env.testing at literal clarity/zod databases on the container, since both RDN query classes hardcode the clarity. prefix.

Added an assertNotified('Unable to update RDN Statistics Push') assertion to the existing test_basic_tier_admin_cannot_toggle_rdn_metrics_push so AC5's error-feedback half is covered on the non-entitled-tier path, not only the non-admin path.

findings_fixed: rn1/claude3 [scoring]: the dispatcher's PHP-side tier filter had ZERO exclusion coverage — the pre-existing test_skips_basic_tier_org_even_when_opted_in writes platform_repo_pro=false, so the SQL predicate drops the org and the in_array is never reached. Deleting the filter (which the deferred de-dup refactor will touch) left the suite green while Clarity would keep pushing a churned customer's counts to RDN. Added test_skips_basic_tier_org_that_passes_the_sql_predicate + test_skips_org_whose_pending_downgrade_to_basic_has_taken_effect. Mutation-verified: removing the filter now fails 2 tests.

rn1/claude2 [scoring]: AC1's render path was untested — narrowing the Blade render gate restored the reported symptom with the whole suite still green. Added an anchored render assertion to the Pro Plus mount test. Mutation-verified: narrowing the gate now fails it.

rn1/claude1 [scoring]: the 'disabled' half of AC5 was unasserted — inverting the notification ternary left all tests green while a user turning the feature OFF saw a green 'enabled' toast. Added assertNotified('RDN Statistics Push enabled'/'disabled') to the on/off tests (both Clarity Pro and Pro Plus). Mutation-verified: inverting the ternary now fails 5 tests.

rn1/claude1 [scoring]: the two danger() paths shared a title, so assertNotified(title) could not tell which branch fired. Replaced with full Notification::make()->title()->body()->danger() assertions (RN2 confirmed this is a strict full-object compare including body/status).

rn2/claude1 [non-scoring 1, applied]: the new aria-checked assertion was not anchored to the RDN control and could false-pass on any element emitting aria-checked. Now assertSeeHtmlInOrder anchored to aria-labelledby="rdn-metrics-push-label". Mutation-verified.
rn2/claude1 [non-scoring 3, applied]: the reverse render-gate direction was unpinned. Added ->assertDontSee('RDN Statistics Push') to the Basic-tier test. Mutation-verified: @if (true) now fails it.
findings_residual: platform_repo_pro JSON type strictness (all 3 rn1 lanes; rn1/claude2 scored it): Org::isProEnabled() is truthiness-based while the dispatcher's ->where('properties->platform_repo_pro', true) compiles to a STRICT jsonb equality. If an org's platform_repo_pro is stored as 1 / "1" rather than a real JSON boolean, the toggle accepts + shows the success toast but the org is never dispatched — AC2 silently fails with no log. PRE-EXISTING and identical for Clarity Pro today; NOT introduced by this diff, and every in-repo writer stores a real boolean. Deliberately not code-changed here (dropping the SQL predicate is a behavior change beyond this bug's scope). MANDATORY QA/prod check: confirm jsonb_typeof(properties->'platform_repo_pro') = 'boolean' for org 541 before closing. Follow-up candidate.

The entitled-tier set is expressed three ways (Blade complement `!== BASIC`, two PHP enumerations). Equivalent today; a 5th ProTierEnum case reproduces this bug verbatim. De-dup deliberately deferred by the product owner — follow-up ticket at handoff.
rn2 non-scoring 2: assertSeeHtmlInOrder is coupled to rendered attribute text; a cosmetic Blade change breaks it with an opaque failure. Accepted trade for pinning the render gate.

rn2 non-scoring 4: DispatchRdnMetricsHourlyTest has no RequiresClickhouse trait, so its positive tests fail (rather than skip) on a box without local ClickHouse. Pre-existing for 4 sibling tests; this diff adds a 5th occurrence.

rn2 non-scoring 5: test_toggle_rdn_metrics_push_on_sends_success_notification and the non-admin notification test are largely subsumed by their siblings now that the assertions were folded into those. Harmless duplication.

rn2 non-scoring 7: enabling the toggle on an org with a blank rdn_id shows a plain success notification; only the mount-time amber note warns that nothing will be sent. AC5 met, but a distinct body would be more honest. Follow-up candidate.

Sibling actions on the same page (requestUpgrade, requestDowngrade, cancelDowngrade) still fail silently with bare returns — the same no-feedback class this ticket fixed, one method over. Out of scope; follow-up candidate.
No Analytics::track() on the toggle, unlike every sibling action on this page. Activity log covers audit but not product analytics.
okf/concepts/rdn.md:49 documents eligibility as the meta flag alone, omitting the tier allow-list and the non-blank rdn_id requirement. Wiki drift; not introduced here.
review.lane_source_note: review.sh's own `claude -p` lanes wrote an error manifest — every raw lane result was `Not logged in · Please run /login` (no child-session auth under this embedded harness). Lanes were re-run in-session as insightlpr:adversarial-reviewer agents (opus, blind, parallel) and RECORDED as in-session-agent, so the substitution is visible rather than silent.

ac.item: RDN Statistics Push toggle responds to user interaction
ac.evidence: A2: the click the ticket reported as dead now flips aria-checked false->true via a Livewire round-trip (no page reload), verified on Clarity Pro Plus (the reported tier). A1 confirmed a real switch renders for Pro Plus; A6/A7 confirmed Pro Lite and Clarity Pro still respond (no regression).

ac.item: Toggling on enables the feature and persists the state
ac.evidence: A2 + A3: toggling on persists and is read back after reload. B2 closes the loop end-to-end — org 5, toggled ON purely through the UI by the browser lane, now appears in DispatchRdnMetricsHourly::eligibleOrgs(), so the write gate and read gate agree in the live environment. B3 confirms the UI-written flag is a real JSON boolean, which is what the dispatcher's strict jsonb predicate requires.

ac.item: Toggling off disables the feature and persists the state
ac.evidence: A4: toggling off sets aria-checked=false, raises the direction-correct 'RDN Statistics Push disabled' toast, and survives a reload. A6/A7 confirmed the off direction on both control tiers.

ac.item: UI reflects the current state accurately on page load
ac.evidence: A5: persona 4 with the flag pre-seeded true renders the switch ON on first paint with no interaction. A3: state read back correctly after a reload. A1: the clean OFF state renders as OFF.

ac.item: Appropriate success/error feedback is shown on toggle
ac.evidence: A2 and A4: success toasts appear on both directions with direction-correct titles, confirmed visually AND in the Livewire response payload (status:'success'). A6/A7 saw both toasts on the control tiers. Error feedback is covered by unit tests rather than this pass (the non-admin and non-entitled-tier danger paths are not reachable from the UI: A9 confirmed a non-admin sees an 'Admin-only' label with no clickable control, and A8 confirmed a Basic org sees no card at all).
